pairs: Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
take up a lamentation over Tyre.
And you shall say to Tyre,
which lives at the entrance to the sea,
which is the marketplace of the peoples for the many islands:
et in corde maris sita. Finitimi tui qui te ædificaverunt,
for I have been positioned at the heart of the sea!’ Your neighbors,
who built you, have filled up your beauty.
abietibus de Sanir exstruxerunt te cum omnibus tabulatis maris:
They constructed you with spruce from Senir, with all the planks of the sea.
cedrum de Libano tulerunt ut facerent tibi malum.
They have taken cedars from Lebanon, so that they might make a mast for you.
Quercus de Basan dolaverunt in remos tuos,
They have formed your oars from the oaks of Bashan.
et transtra tua fecerunt tibi ex ebore indico,
And they have made your crossbeams from Indian ivory,
and the pilothouse is from the islands of Italy.
Byssus varia de Ægypto texta est tibi in velum ut poneretur in malo:
Colorful fine linen from Egypt was woven for you as a sail to be placed upon the mast;
hyacinthus et purpura de insulis Elisa facta sunt operimentum tuum.
hyacinth and purple from the islands of Elishah were made into your covering.
Habitatores Sidonis et Aradii fuerunt remiges tui:
The inhabitants of Sidon and of Arwad were your rowers.
Senes Giblii et prudentes ejus habuerunt nautas ad ministerium variæ supellectilis tuæ:
and its experts were considered as sailors making use of your diverse equipment.
All the ships of the sea
and their sailors were your merchants among the people.
et Libyes erant in exercitu tuo viri bellatores tui:
and the Libyans were your men of war in your army.
clypeum et galeam suspenderunt in te pro ornatu tuo.
They suspended shield and helmet within you for your adornment.
Filii Aradii cum exercitu tuo erant super muros tuos in circuitu:
The sons of Arwad were with your army upon your walls all around.
et Pigmæi qui erant in turribus tuis,
pharetras suas suspenderunt in muris tuis per gyrum:
suspended their quivers on your walls on all sides;
supplied your festivals with a multitude of diverse riches,
they traveled to your people with slaves
et vasa ærea advexerunt populo tuo.
et mulos adduxerunt ad forum tuum.
The sons of Dedan were your merchants.
The many islands were the marketplace of your hand.
dentes eburneos et hebeninos commutaverunt in pretio tuo.
and of ebony for your price.
Syrus negotiator tuus propter multitudinem operum tuorum:
The Syrian was your merchant. Because of the multitude of your works,
et chodchod proposuerunt in mercatu tuo.
and silk, and other valuables in your market.
Judah and the land of Israel,
ipsi institores tui in frumento primo:
these were your peddlers of the best grain;
et resinam proposuerunt in nundinis tuis.
Damascenus negotiator tuus in multitudine operum tuorum,
The Damascene was your trader in the multitude of your works,
in wool with the finest coloring.
and Mosel have offered works made of iron at your festivals.
in nundinis tuis proposuerunt ferrum fabrefactum:
stacte et calamus in negotiatione tua.
and sweet flag were in your marketplace.
Dedan institores tui in tapetibus ad sedendum.
The men of Dedan were your peddlers of tapestries used as seats.
and all the leaders of Kedar,
these were the merchants at your hand.
Your merchants came to you with lambs,
The vendors of Sheba and Raamah,
which they offered in your marketplace.
These were your merchants in many places,
with windings of hyacinth and of colorful weavings,
which were wrapped and bound with cords.
quæ obvolutæ et astrictæ erant funibus:
cedros quoque habebant in negotiationibus tuis.
they had works of cedar among your merchandise.
Naves maris, principes tui in negotiatione tua:
The ships of the sea were important to your business dealings.
et repleta es, et glorificata nimis in corde maris.
For you were replenished and exceedingly glorified in the heart of the sea.
In aquis multis adduxerunt te remiges tui:
Your rowers have brought you into many waters.
ventus auster contrivit te in corde maris.
The south wind has worn you down in the heart of the sea.
qui tenebant supellectilem tuam, et populo tuo præerant:
who handle your goods and who were first among your people,
cum universa multitudine tua quæ est in medio tui, cadent in corde maris in die ruinæ tuæ:
and your entire multitude that is in your midst: they will fall in the heart of the sea on the day of your ruin.
a sonitu clamoris gubernatorum tuorum conturbabuntur classes.
Your fleets will be disturbed by the sound of an outcry from your navigators.
Et descendent de navibus suis omnes qui tenebant remum:
And all who were handling the oar will descend from their ships;
nautæ et universi gubernatores maris in terra stabunt.
the sailors and all the navigators of the sea will stand upon the land.
Et ejulabunt super te voce magna:
And they will howl over you with a great voice,
and they will cry out with bitterness.
And they will cast dust upon their heads,
and they will be sprinkled with ashes.
And they will shave their heads because of you,
and they will be wrapped in haircloth.
et plorabunt te in amaritudine animæ,
And they will weep for you with bitterness of soul,
Et assument super te carmen lugubre,
And they will take up a mournful verse over you,
which has become mute in the midst of the sea?’
Quæ in exitu negotiationum tuarum de mari implesti populos multos:
For by the going forth of your merchandise by sea,
by the multitude of your riches and of your people,
you enriched the kings of the earth.
Now you have been worn away by the sea,
your opulence is in the depths of the waters,
et omnis multitudo tua quæ erat in medio tui, ceciderunt.
and your entire multitude that was in your midst has fallen.
Universi habitatores insularum obstupuerunt super te,
All the inhabitants of the islands have been stupefied over you;
et reges earum omnes tempestate perculsi mutaverunt vultus.
and all their kings, having been struck by the tempest, have changed their expression.
The merchants of the peoples have hissed over you.
You have been reduced to nothing,
et non eris usque in perpetuum.
and you shall not be again, even forever.”
